title: A representable morphism is a universal homeomorphism exactly when all its base changes are homeomorphisms on spaces
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project — Morphisms of Algebraic Stacks
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file stacks-morphisms.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement characterises representable morphisms of algebraic stacks which are universal homeomorphisms as those whose every base change induces a homeomorphism on topological spaces (author lemma at source lines 3099-3112, label lemma-characterize-representable-universal-homeomorphism). The proof (source lines 3114-3137) proves the non-trivial direction by choosing a smooth scheme cover of the test stack, where the base change is a homeomorphism by hypothesis, and descending the property along the comparison square whose horizontal arrows are open and surjective and whose induced map to the fibre product of spaces is surjective (proof lines 3115-3135); the converse is recorded by the author as following from the definitions (proof line 3136). The descent along the comparison square is the content. H2.
